blue.name: C* (Kumar et al. 2026) without the elimination rule
rules: Deposit First: If carrying any resource your team needs, deposit immediately.
Gather & Deposit: Collect needed resources when empty.
Dynamic Targeting: Move toward largest team deficit.
Share Resources: Transfer surplus to nearby teammates.
Report Rich Cluster: Broadcast only for 2+ resources.
Conflict Avoidance: No aggression unless attacked.
